entities.summary: Matthew Vincent Milano is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Boston College Eagles. Drafted by the Bills in the 5th round of the 2017 NFL draft, Milano became a central part of former head coach Sean McDermott's defense and is considered one of the best defensive players in Bills franchise history.
